I was so excited to try and try these sheets! I am quite a warm sleeper, so I was looking forward to the “cooling” effect of these sheets. They fit ok, and stretch out like most sheets over a period of days. 

They’re trash. They feel like microfiber sheets. They are not at all breathable, or cooling. My husband feels like he sticks to them. I’m giving 2 stars because I really love the color.


Update 7/4/26
Changing my review to 1 star because the seller messaged me asking to change my review in exchange for a 5% discount.
